Effects stay on the original player ship when control changes. Empty profiles
return exact baseline efficiency. Town panel opens the authoritative host modal.

Validation: build --code passes ownership, shell layers, AST equivalence and
source fingerprint checks (188 sources, 42 ship files); actual effCalc isolation
checks pass with world recruitment tests. No ship configuration changes.
